# --- documentation-ish lines that mention secrets without being one ---

The deploy token lives in the CI secret store, not in the repo.

Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your shell before running the qualification fixture.

password reset emails are sent by the auth service

Rotate the API key quarterly; the runbook explains how.

recall.embedding and recall.rerank are global-only for security reasons.

sync.remote can only be set in global settings; project value ignored
